primary_grievance_category.description: The primary category of the customer's complaint or grievance, classified into standard areas such as billing/pricing, product quality/defect, delivery/shipping, customer service behavior, or technical support.

requested_resolution_type.description: The specific type of resolution or corrective action requested by the customer, categorized into options like refund/reimbursement, product replacement/repair, contract cancellation, service reactivation, or information/explanation.
